scope: Failure-mode coverage, not a prediction of supplier uptime or next-run success probability

risks.scenario: Cross-isolate response timestamp1/2ms ahead of receiver
risks.coverage: full139-batch compound + strict native timer test
risks.mitigation: bounded I/O clock refresh; unchanged timestamps and zero future tolerance

risks.scenario: 250ms quote response misses a minute slot preallocated220ms later
risks.coverage: reproduced932 requests then1400 reservation exhaustion; same553-input after-fix formula/rank/hash match
risks.mitigation: defer minute allocation until quote success; retire only expired never-started cells with durable tombstones
risks.residual: actual supplier/control latency can exceed the tested envelope

risks.scenario: 139 batches,2 lanes each,8 global leases,350ms control RTT, sparse twice-retried15s timeouts and lost completion ACKs
risks.coverage: actual shard retry/slot/model code +SQLite +virtual time; NOT a Cloud timing forecast
risks.mitigation: fixed IDs, queued durable leases, paced unique slots, bounded retries
risks.residual: large-scale outage cannot complete within unchanged Free/request/time caps

risks.scenario: durable observation committed but completion response lost
risks.coverage: one identical-byte retry; persistent loss stops after2; explicit storage rejection is not retried
risks.mitigation: same-content completion ACK retry only; no market recollection
risks.residual: persistent storage/control outage remains a blocking failure

risks.scenario: receiver restart after reservations or after outbox/remote write
risks.coverage: persistent lease fences, lost credits remain charged, tombstone readback, frozen relay retry
risks.mitigation: immutable evidence and first issuance, never reclaim an already attempted symbol
risks.residual: an in-flight market response lost with the process is not reconstructed or recollected automatically

risks.coverage: bounded transient retry; malformed/nontransient fails; complete universe is mandatory
risks.mitigation: maximum3 endpoint attempts with original spacing/budgets; allowlisted network-cause codes only
risks.residual: Oct28 unknown transport cause remains unidentified; retries do not prove root cause

risks.scenario: late/missing EOD,hash mismatch,holiday or insufficient token TTL
risks.coverage: fresh final-input attempts and pinned-seed/token tests
risks.mitigation: 13:40 prep and13:59 recheck; no stale-data substitution or token refresh during observation
risks.residual: next trading-day availability must be checked at actual preparation time

risks.scenario: SQL exhaustion,delayed account analytics,other Workers or persistent storage growth
risks.coverage: collection/diagnostic reserve tests; daily vs monthly metrics separated; conservative account lag reserve
risks.mitigation: hard local caps + platformFree caps; no paid fallback; retained storage does not reset daily
risks.residual: runtime Worker has no account-management credential; static reservations are not a fresh account-wide admission measurement

risks.scenario: immutable write committed but ACK lost,duplicate transfer or restarted relay
risks.coverage: same frozen hash and first issuance through ordinary private-store reader;5-session contract remains unchanged
risks.mitigation: readback before head publication; bounded same-content relay
risks.residual: repository/PAT/Vercel outages may prevent publication despite successful collection

risks.scenario: private repository is current but Vercel authenticated reader is not
risks.coverage: existing anonymous boundary checks only in active Cloud watchdog
risks.mitigation: separate minimal machine-attestation branch prepared, NOT active in this release
risks.residual: requires explicit separate endpoint/key activation; no admin password or cookie copied to Cloud

interpretation: PASS means this exact failure injection is handled or correctly blocked. It never means every tomorrow failure is predictable, synthetic data is live, or a numerical success probability is established.
